title: AppConfiguration
description: App-wide UI configuration. It exists both in the server configuration (yaml/env) and in the database, and configSource.app (APP_CONFIG_SOURCE, default DB) decides which one wins. In DB mode the stored value wins, and the server configuration only fills values the stored setting lacks.

defaultAppMode.description: Tenant-wide 'first impression' app-mode default. Seeds the app mode for users who have not chosen one; user preference and persona-level app mode still win over this default. Null means no tenant default is configured.
